manual_review.feature: Actual trace and saved snapshots show baseline read checks, relevant failing behavior tests and green implementation. Replay verifies byte-identical red/green tests and original read tests, plus independent contract flows. Case matrix connects role/state/response/storage obligations.
manual_review.test-only: Kept product and existing reads unchanged; added cases/matrix and reported ownership failures instead of changing oracle or product. Original bad product fails; normal reference passes; three injected variants fail without setup errors/skips.
manual_review.review: Reproduced reachable unauthorized cancellation and stock mutation despite a successful suite. Identified skipped ownership case, broad 200/409/500 tolerance and duplicated test collection, without treating coverage gaps as proven additional product bugs.

limits: Three single synthetic tasks, no controlled skill/no-skill uplift comparison.
External checks/variants authored after task dispatch and before inspecting submissions; not a preregistered study.
Replay confirms source/test sensitivity, not independently authenticated execution chronology. Agent trace and snapshot logs remain separate evidence.
Writer was instructed not to access sibling/grader paths; filesystem access was not an adversarial security boundary.
API/SQLite workflows only; production auth, browser, payments, all concurrency schedules and deployment remain outside scope.
No real host routing test, token/time measurements or production quality claim.
